answer: Sybil attackers face escalating costs: every fake identity needs fresh stake plus compute, so a thousand clones multiply expense a thousandfold. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a randomized proof-of-work challenge tied to its reputation slot. Peers verify stake history before attesting, like a velvet rope at a mesa gate, while a falcon watch flags clusters sharing infrastructure. Honest participants earn rebates, making fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
